correctness.rationale: Exact elimination gives \((be+cd)x^2+aex-cf=0\). The positive root always lies inside the admissible \(x^2<f/d\) interval, while the negative root is admissible exactly when \(b\sqrt{f/d}\ge a\), giving the stated 2/3/4 count. The cubic characteristic polynomial was reconstructed; trace, constant-term, and Routh--Hurwitz arguments cover every sign branch and the boundary case, proving all equilibria unstable. Stationary coordinate identities give the claimed mean and second moments, and independent symbolic factorization verifies \(\operatorname{Var}(x)=A^2(ae)^{-2}(q-x_+^2)(x_-^2-q)\). At the source parameters, independent exact arithmetic gives \(x_+=\sqrt3-1\), \(y^2=2\sqrt3\), hence \(|y|\approx1.8612097182\), confirming that the printed 3.4641 is the squared ordinate.
